comparison.objective: Connect and route a door-lamp cord, then latch and cycle a junction-box door.
comparison.physical_skill: Plug insertion, cord placement under a clip, latch operation, and routing across a moving hinge.
comparison.success_condition: Plug seated, cord clipped, door latched and surviving an open-close inspection; trapped cord or premature closure can zero.
comparison.reason: Tests cable routing and persistence across articulated-door motion, not selective bulk separation.
